summary: The candidate is a functional partial fix: it selects the requested native or Hugging Face MTP layer shards plus draft-wide shared shards before constructing the RunAI iterator, and safely falls back for the candidate's tested missing, malformed, unknown-layout, absent-layer, and absent-shard cases. However, it does not safely handle an incomplete index when existing loader logic has deliberately auto-added an unindexed mtp.safetensors file. In that real call path, the candidate prunes the supplemental file and can make a previously loadable checkpoint partial.

tests.what_was_measured: Captured the exact shard list passed to runai_safetensors_weights_iterator for both required layouts. The base passed all target and draft shards, reproducing the original excess-I/O behavior.
Candidate regression suite: 15 tests and 6 subtests passed, including iterator input-list assertions and advertised fallbacks.
Independent iterator capture confirmed both model.mtp.layers.<index> and mtp.<index> layouts select only the requested layer shard and draft-wide shared shard.

Real _get_weights_iterator call order with Glm4Moe metadata and an unindexed mtp.safetensors. maybe_add_mtp_safetensors added the required supplemental file, but _select_mtp_safetensors removed it before the RunAI iterator; the independent assertion failed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The changed behavior is deterministic JSON index parsing and pre-iterator Python file-list selection. No tensor computation or GPU kernel/native path changed, so GPU numerical execution would not validate this contract.

native_rebuild_reason: The candidate changes only Python loader/test/report files and no native source or extension. The loaded source was confirmed as /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/model_loader/loader.py under both revisions.
remaining_counterexamples: When maybe_add_mtp_safetensors appends an existing mtp.safetensors that is absent from the index, and the same index contains a recognized requested-layer entry, _select_mtp_safetensors drops the auto-added file instead of falling back to the complete prepared list. This contradicts the safe fallback requirement for incomplete index metadata and can omit required draft tensors.
remaining_limitations: No object-storage credentials or large production MTP checkpoint were available, so remote provider I/O reduction was verified through URI/path-list behavior rather than live header-read counts.
No model weights were needed or used; full model semantic accuracy and distributed loading were not exercised.
GPU execution and native rebuild were not applicable to this Python-only file-selection change.
